excerpt: These criteria were informed in part by Meta’s recent Frontier AI Framework.
paraphrase: Footnote acknowledges Meta's Frontier AI Framework informed these criteria.

excerpt: Threat models are informed both by our broader risk assessment process, and by more specific information that we gather across OpenAI teams and external experts.
paraphrase: Threat models draw on both the broader risk assessment process and specific information gathered internally and externally.

excerpt: While past deployment experiences are an important source of information about existing risks, we also recognize that in the case of net-new risks of severe harm, significant safeguards may be needed to reduce the risk of harms that have never been realized.
paraphrase: Past deployment experience informs risk understanding, but net-new severe harm risks may require significant safeguards even absent realized harms.

excerpt: Our team develops or adopts evaluations designed to track progress on each of these capabilities and to indicate when the identified capability thresholds may have been reached.
paraphrase: The team develops or adopts evaluations to track capability progress and flag when thresholds may be reached.

excerpt: We further break down the specific capability thresholds, associated risks, and safeguards for those thresholds in Table 1.
paraphrase: Table 1 further details capability thresholds, associated risks, and safeguards.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Capability threshold / High
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Capability threshold that could lead to the risk — High
excerpt: The model can provide meaningful counterfactual assistance (relative to unlimited access to baseline of tools available in 2021) to “novice” actors (anyone with a basic relevant technical background) that enables them to create known biological or chemical threats.
paraphrase: High threshold: the model meaningfully helps novice actors, beyond 2021 baseline tools, create known bio/chemical threats.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Associated risk / High
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Associated risk of severe harm — High
excerpt: Significantly increased likelihood and frequency of biological or chemical terror events by non-state actors using known reference-class threats.
paraphrase: High-level risk: significantly greater likelihood/frequency of bio/chemical terror events by non-state actors using known threat types.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Safeguard guidelines / High / bullet 1
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Risk-specific safeguard guidelines — High
excerpt: Require security controls meeting High standard (Appendix C.3)
paraphrase: Requires security controls meeting the High standard per Appendix C.3.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Safeguard guidelines / High / bullet 2
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Risk-specific safeguard guidelines — High
excerpt: Require safeguards against misuse meeting High standard (Appendix C.1) before external deployment
paraphrase: Requires misuse safeguards meeting the High standard per Appendix C.1 prior to external deployment.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Capability threshold / Critical
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Capability threshold that could lead to the risk — Critical
excerpt: The model can enable an expert to develop a highly dangerous novel threat vector (e.g., comparable to a novel CDC Class A biological agent) OR the model can be connected to tools and equipment to complete the full engineering and/or synthesis cycle of a regulated or novel biological threat without human intervention.
paraphrase: Critical threshold: the model enables experts to develop novel highly dangerous threat vectors, or can autonomously complete full engineering/synthesis of a regulated or novel biological threat.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Associated risk / Critical
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Associated risk of severe harm — Critical
excerpt: Proliferating the ability to create a novel threat vector of the severity of a CDC Class A biological agent (i.e., high mortality, ease of transmission) could cause millions of deaths and significantly disrupt public life, with few available societal safeguards.
paraphrase: Critical risk: proliferation of a CDC Class A-level threat vector could cause millions of deaths and severe societal disruption with few available safeguards.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Safeguard guidelines / Critical / bullet 1
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Risk-specific safeguard guidelines — Critical
excerpt: Until we have specified safeguards and security controls that would meet a Critical standard, halt further development
paraphrase: Development halts until safeguards and security controls meeting the Critical standard are specified.

locator: Table 1 / Biological and Chemical / Safeguard guidelines / Critical / bullet 2
context_stem: Tracked Category: Biological and Chemical — Risk-specific safeguard guidelines — Critical
excerpt: Contribute towards improved public policy and pandemic preparedness
paraphrase: Contribute to improved public policy and pandemic preparedness efforts.

excerpt: We will build safeguards against both biological and chemical threats.
paraphrase: Safeguards will be built against both biological and chemical threats.

excerpt: Given the higher potential severity of biological threats relative to chemical ones, we will prioritize Biological capability evaluations and these will be used as indicators for High and Critical capabilities for the category.
paraphrase: Because biological threats are potentially more severe, biological capability evaluations will be prioritized as indicators for High and Critical thresholds.
